name: Mushroom Ring (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-00: The King in Thorns

disable: DC 15 Thievery check (trained) or DC 18 Nature check to rearrange the mushrooms to disrupt the portal (two actions); three successes are required to disable the portal
routine: (1 action) A Pugwampi emerges from the mushroom ring and defends it. All pugwampis use the mushroom ring's initiative.

items.name: Portal
items.text:
Trigger The PCs approach the mushroom ring

---
Effect A Pugwampi emerges from the portal to defend it, and the hazard then rolls initiative.

text: This mushroom ring forms a portal to the First World, allowing the Thorned Monarch's reinforcements into the Material Plane. When the PCs approach, a creature emerges. Creatures continue to emerge until the mushroom ring is disabled. Disabling the mushroom ring also causes any creatures that have emerged to disappear.
